about: What this map is, read with the rest of its folder (docs/design/maps-as-data.md). Sea level and expects are in land units of 0.125 m; landShare is the percent of cells at or above the sea level; the water is drawn 0.1 m under it. sea: where the swell comes in from, a point on the coast and the way out, in world metres (left out, worked out from the low land). yard: the old chemistry yard in cells (x, y, width, height), whose south-west cell stands at world (0, 0); fullDetail: the chunks drawn in full detail (i0, j0, i1, j1). MapCheck holds the folder to them. dresses: the places that stay code which this map wants built (PlaceRoot).
